subject: [PATCH 0/6] daxctl: use dax kmem atomic whole-device hotplug

2026-10-29.patch_summary: This patch series introduces support for atomic whole-device hotplug in daxctl using the dax_kmem attribute. This allows for safe and concurrent online and offline operations on a device, preventing races between agents like udev and auto-online. The patch also updates the 'daxctl list' command to report the hotplug state of devices, which can be inconsistent if blocks are toggled individually. The changes maintain compatibility with older daxctl versions and handle cases where unplug or re-adding fails due to lack of memory hotremove support or region reservation issues.
